```
['build a python module that subclasses BaseHead and implements forward, predict, and loss methods', 'review the BaseHead abstract forward method that processes feature tensors through the network', 'review the BaseHead abstract predict method that predicts results from extracted features', 'review the BaseHead abstract loss method that calculates losses from inputs and data samples', 'review the BaseHead decode method that decodes keypoints from network outputs into InstanceData']
```

